Definition: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to call, call out, recite, read, cry out, proclaim; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to call, cry, utter a loud sound; 1a2) to call unto, cry (for help), call (with name of God); 1a3) to proclaim; 1a4) to read aloud, read (to oneself), read; 1a5) to summon, invite, call for, call and commission, appoint, call and endow; 1a6) to call, name, give name to, call by; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to call oneself; 1b2) to be called, be proclaimed, be read aloud, be summoned, be named; 1c) (Pual) to be called, be named, be called out, be chosen
